text:
anna-docs: FYI PR #502 is up for the model-catalog change that clarifies supported IO shapes for AuroraX-lite. I added a draft compatibility note but need a quick sanity check on the SDK examples and the bench numbers. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/502

jess-sdk: taking a look now. Do we want to show the new behavior in both Python and TS snippets? I can add a tiny TS example for streaming + kv-cache usage.

ben-ml: bench summary attached in the PR comment — short version: for aurora-lite (quantized) tail latency spikes at seq>4096 when prefix caching disabled. We should update the "sequence limits" column and call out the degraded p95 for quantized variants.

carmen-eng: Is the spike reproducible on our Dedicated infra or just edge cases on small VMs? If Dedicated we might need a runtime note about fallback to aurora-xl variant.

ben-ml: reproduced on a t4-like test harness with identical model artifacts. Dedicated shows same pattern under synthetic IO-bound load. Kernel selection logs point to an attention tiling fallback.

anna-docs: ok, so action items: (1) update table row for AuroraX-lite with "recommended max context" and a note about p95 regression; (2) add a short migration snippet showing how to pin model variant and fallback policy; (3) add TS + Py SDK examples that explicitly enable prefix caching.

jess-sdk: draft Py snippet (will add to PR):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate("aurora-x-lite", prompt, cache_prefix=True, max_tokens=128)
print(resp.text)
```

and TS sketch: 
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const rw = new Redwood()
const r = await rw.generate({ model: 'aurora-x-lite', prompt, cachePrefix: true })
console.log(r.output)
```

sam-prod: small request from product: include a one-line backward compatibility blurb for teams on Dedicated that rely on seq>4096—recommend pinning variant to `aurora-xl` if they need stable latency. Also add a short note about how costs may change with that pin.

anna-docs: will add. Carmen, can you post the kernel selection log snippet so I can quote it?

carmen-eng: pasted below (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-21T14:02:33Z] model=aurora-x-lite kernel=attention_tiler fallback=attention_generic seq=8192 batch=1 reason=tile_not_supported
[2026-03-21T14:02:33Z] qkv-path=quantized path=slow_kernel p95=412ms
```

jess-sdk: thanks — I'll reference that as "attention tiling fallback on long sequences" and add a tiny note in the SDK docs about enabling `cache_prefix` to avoid re-computation on repeated prefixes.

anna-docs: CI bot flagged a docs lint failure on the PR (link in threads). Looks like a small markdown anchor issue and one missing code fence language.

deploy-bot: [auto] docs-lint failed for PR #502: MD042/MD013 — line length and missing code language. See https://ci.redwood-inference.com/job/502/logs

jess-sdk: fixed the code fence and pushed a tiny commit to the PR.

ben-ml: one more thing — please include the bench CSV (aggregated) as a Gist link instead of embedding huge tables. I put the gist in the PR comment: https://gist.github.com/ben/aurora-lite-bench-2026

anna-docs: great. Plan: I will update the model-catalog CSV row, add the migration blurb, include both SDK snippets, reference the kernel log and the bench gist, and address CI lint errors. If no objections I'll merge after another +1. Aiming to merge today.

sam-prod: +1 on content. Make sure the cost callout is clear.

carmen-eng: +1 for accuracy. Might add a follow-up note in runtime docs about attention tiling soon.

jess-sdk: +1 for SDK examples. I'll watch for any follow-up SDK review items after merge.

anna-docs: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll ping again when it's merged. :rocket:
